Item 8.01 Other Events.
On May 12, 2026, Celesta Biosciences, Inc. (the "Company") issued a press release announcing topline results from its Phase 3 pivotal trial (protocol CB-401-P3) of CBX-4402 in patients with treatment-refractory eosinophilic esophagitis. The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of statistically significant reduction in peak eosinophil count at Week 24 (p = 0.184; pre-specified alpha = 0.025). The Company also disclosed that the secondary endpoint of dysphagia symptom score also did not achieve statistical significance.

Item 3.02 Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities.
On May 8, 2026, the Company issued 3,412,000 shares of its common stock in a private placement to Longbrook Ventures IV, L.P. and Palomar Growth Fund II, L.P. at a price of $14.20 per share, for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $48.4 million. The shares were issued in reliance on Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933 and Rule 506(b) of Regulation D. The Company has agreed to file a resale registration statement covering these shares within 45 days of issuance.

Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers.
Effective May 10, 2026, Dr. Kenji T. Matsuoka resigned from his position as Chief Medical Officer of the Company to pursue other opportunities. Dr. Matsuoka will remain available in a consulting capacity through August 31, 2026. The Company has commenced a search for a permanent successor and has appointed Dr. Priya Chandrasekaran, the Company's SVP of Clinical Development, as Interim Chief Medical Officer.

TRADING HALT AND MARKET IMPACT
Following the pre-market announcement, Nasdaq halted trading in CELB from 8:44 a.m. ET until 10:15 a.m. ET on May 12, 2026. Upon resumption of trading, the stock opened at $6.18, a decline of 62% from the previous day's closing price of $16.24, on trading volume of 47.8 million shares (approximately 22 times the trailing 30-day average daily volume).

- May 6, 2026: Chief Medical Officer Kenji T. Matsuoka sold 33,700 shares at a weighted average price of $16.42. This transaction was not made pursuant to a 10b5-1 plan.
